# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

    return -float(node.id)

    out: list[Move] = []
    return out

# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    total = 0.0
    m = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(m):
        s = ctx.graph.src[e]
        d = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if s == pod.id:
            other = d
        if d == pod.id:
            other = s
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 1:
                total += ctx.graph.rate[e] * node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
    cpu_after = node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request
    mem_after = node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request
    cpu_head = 0.0
    if node.cpu_capacity > 0:
        cpu_head = float(node.cpu_capacity - cpu_after) / float(node.cpu_capacity)
    mem_head = 0.0
    if node.mem_capacity > 0:
        mem_head = float(node.mem_capacity - mem_after) / float(node.mem_capacity)
    pressure = 0.0
    if cpu_head < 0.25:
        pressure += (0.25 - cpu_head) * 100.0
    if mem_head < 0.25:
        pressure += (0.25 - mem_head) * 100.0
    return -(total + pressure)

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moved = 0
    m = len(graph.src)
    for e in range(m):
        if moved >= budget:
            return out
        rate = graph.rate[e]
        if rate > 1.0:
            sp = state.pods[graph.src[e]]
            dp = state.pods[graph.dst[e]]
            placed = sp.current_node >= 0 and dp.current_node >= 0
            if placed and sp.current_node != dp.current_node:
                src_node = state.nodes[sp.current_node]
                dst_node = state.nodes[dp.current_node]
                src_cap = src_node.cpu_capacity > 0 and src_node.mem_capacity > 0
                dst_cap = dst_node.cpu_capacity > 0 and dst_node.mem_capacity > 0
                if src_cap and dst_cap:
                    src_load = float(src_node.cpu_allocated) / float(src_node.cpu_capacity)
                    dst_load = float(dst_node.cpu_allocated) / float(dst_node.cpu_capacity)
                    move_sp = src_load > dst_load and not sp.stateful and not sp.has_pdb
                    move_dp = dst_load > src_load and not dp.stateful and not dp.has_pdb
                    if move_sp:
                        cpu_ok = dst_node.cpu_allocated + sp.cpu_request <= dst_node.cpu_capacity
                        mem_ok = dst_node.mem_allocated + sp.mem_request <= dst_node.mem_capacity
                        if cpu_ok and mem_ok and not dst_node.suspended:
                            out.append(move_pod(sp.id, dp.current_node))
                            moved += 1
                    elif move_dp:
                        cpu_ok2 = src_node.cpu_allocated + dp.cpu_request <= src_node.cpu_capacity
                        mem_ok2 = src_node.mem_allocated + dp.mem_request <= src_node.mem_capacity
                        if cpu_ok2 and mem_ok2 and not src_node.suspended:
                            out.append(move_pod(dp.id, sp.current_node))
                            moved += 1
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
